slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize the total annual net income from all farm activities (crops, dairy cows, chickens) plus the earnings from external work?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what the objective is, specifically inquiring whether it is to maximize total annual net income, which fully covers the hidden slot's key meaning.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot (objective) was explicitly asked and confirmed in turn 1 before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, so no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained at stopping.

summary: The agent directly and explicitly confirmed the optimization objective (maximize total annual net income) in its first question, resolving the sole P0 hidden slot before modeling; the interaction is clean and well-targeted.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
